disclosure: Prospective experiments only. No result, buyer validation, payment, or lifecycle maturity is claimed.

experiments.hypothesis: Agent-platform vendors will pay for a signed MCP/A2A composition regression report.
experiments.successThreshold: 3 agree to run a real endpoint and 1 signs a paid pilot or equivalent commitment

experiments.hypothesis: eFTI vendors need private multi-version interoperability tests before certification.
experiments.successThreshold: 2 provide a real fixture or paid discovery commitment
experiments.killThreshold: no owner accepts a private test artifact

experiments.hypothesis: DPP platforms will run a preflight against registry/API semantics before customer submission.
experiments.successThreshold: 2 run a supplied fixture and 1 requests integration pricing
experiments.killThreshold: all vendors already ship equivalent checks

experiments.hypothesis: Import procurement teams need a reusable MRV evidence packet for 2027 contracts.
experiments.successThreshold: 3 share a real evidence workflow and 1 pays for a manual packet
experiments.killThreshold: no buyer can identify a contract decision affected

experiments.hypothesis: Cloud buyers will pay for an observed export-and-restore drill beyond existing export tooling.
experiments.successThreshold: 2 execute a restore fixture and 1 commits to a paid drill
experiments.killThreshold: all accept existing EscapeCloud/internal scripts as sufficient

experiments.hypothesis: Utilities or aggregators accept third-party flexibility drill evidence.
experiments.successThreshold: 2 name an accepted evidence format and 1 sponsors a replay
experiments.killThreshold: no external party accepts the evidence boundary

experiments.hypothesis: Medical-device teams have unresolved reverse-reconciliation gaps after registry changes.
experiments.successThreshold: 2 show a recurring drift incident and 1 requests a paid reconciliation
experiments.killThreshold: all rely on bundled system reconciliation

experiments.hypothesis: Robotics teams need field-update evidence beyond existing QMS tooling.
experiments.successThreshold: 2 provide a release fixture and 1 funds a field-update review

experiments.hypothesis: Security teams need application-level crypto swap tests rather than another inventory report.
experiments.successThreshold: 3 identify a blocked migration and 1 runs a paid swap test
experiments.killThreshold: inventory vendors already execute the required behavior

experiments.hypothesis: Investigation owners need a shared evidence room during a forced-labour case.
experiments.successThreshold: 2 replay a case and 1 pays for a bounded response room
experiments.killThreshold: no recurring case workflow or budget owner

experiments.hypothesis: Chemical sellers will pay to catch label/SDS/webshop drift before release.
experiments.successThreshold: 3 provide multi-surface fixtures and 1 pays for a release gate
experiments.killThreshold: existing scanners cover the full workflow
